answer_2.quote: We report four distributional alignment metrics: (i) Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, (ii) Jensen-Shannon (JS) distance, (iii) Entropy Gap (∆H), and (iv) Total Variation (TV) distance.

answer_3.quote: The behavior summary map g is implemented with an LLM-based classifier, specifically gpt-4.1 at a temperature 0 setting to ensure deterministic output. Each call receives a structured prompt that concatenates the agent's complete state-action trajectory ... to return a single predicted behavior class label.
